sentences.japanese: 私は一日に100ユーロ稼ぎます。
お金を稼ぎたいならアメリカが一番だ。
sentences.english: America is a lovely place to be, if you are here to earn money.

sentences.japanese: 寝てるな、寝ながらお金を稼げるなら別だが。
sentences.english: Don't stay in bed, unless you can make money in bed.

sentences.japanese: 我々の稼ぎは実力に比例している。
sentences.english: Our earnings are in proportion to our real ability.

sentences.japanese: 稼ぐに追いつく貧乏なし。
sentences.english: No poverty can catch up with industry.
